title: Chiropractic Care, Medication, and Self-Care for Neck Pain
brief_summary: This study will compare the effectiveness of chiropractic care, medications, and self-care on neck pain, a very common condition. The broad, long-term objective of this study is to identify effective therapies for neck pain sufferers and to increase understanding of neck pain conditions.
raw_criteria:
Exclusion Criteria:
